faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Trokacha

q1.question: How to download Trokacha?
q1.answer: Trokacha is available for free on the App Store (iOS) and Google Play (Android). Download the app and create your account in seconds.

q2.question: How do I make an offer on Trokacha?
q2.answer: Open the listing you like and tap “Make an offer”: propose 1 or 2 of your items, an amount, or both. Whoever receives it can tap “I'm interested” to talk it over, then “Conclude” with the offer they choose. You then set the meeting together.

q3.question: Is parcel transport secure?
q3.answer: Yes! Each carrier is verified and rated by the community. You can track your parcel in real-time and communicate directly with the carrier.

q4.question: Is Trokacha free?
q4.answer: Yes, Trokacha is completely free! No hidden fees, no subscription. Our business model is based on optional premium features.

q5.question: In which cities is Trokacha available?
q5.answer: Trokacha is available in all wilayas of Algeria. Our goal: to connect Algerians from Tamanrasset to Annaba!

q6.question: How to become a carrier on Trokacha?
q6.answer: Just create an account and activate the carrier option. You can then see transport requests on your routes and offer your services.

q7.question: How do I rent on Trokacha?
q7.answer: Open the rental listing, pick your dates and tap “Request the rental”. As soon as the owner accepts, the dates are booked for you. You then agree together on the key handover.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: In accordance with Law 18-07 of June 10, 2018 relating to the protection of natural persons in the processing of personal data, amended by Law 11-25 of July 2025, Trokacha is committed to protecting the personal data of its users.

a2.title: Article 2 – Data Collected
a2.intro: Trokacha only collects data necessary for the operation of the service:

s1.title: 2.1 – Identification Data
items: Last name, first name, date of birth
Email address, phone number
Profile photo (optional)

s2.title: 2.2 – Identity Verification Data
items: Photo of an official identity document (national ID card, driver's license or passport)
Verification selfie for comparison with the identity document
For drivers (carpooling and transport services): copy of driver's license
s2.note: This data is processed solely to verify the user's identity and assign the "Verified User" badge. Identity document images are stored encrypted during the verification period, then deleted within 30 days after badge validation. Only the verification status (verified/unverified) is retained thereafter.

s3.title: 2.3 – Geolocation Data
items: User's geographic position (with explicit consent)
Used for: displaying nearby ads, carpooling and parcel transport services
Geolocation only works when the app is active (no background collection)
The user can disable geolocation at any time in their device settings

s4.title: 2.4 – Transaction and Usage Data
items: History of published ads, proposed and completed exchanges
User ratings and reviews
Messages exchanged via built-in chat (text, photos, voice messages, documents)
Browsing and platform usage data (pages visited, session duration)
Points, badges and gamification data

s5.title: 2.5 – Technical Data
items: IP address
Operating system type and version (iOS, Android)
Device model
Unique device identifier
Performance and diagnostic data (crashes, errors)

a3.title: Article 3 – Legal Basis for Processing
items: Consent: the user gives express and informed consent during registration and activation of each feature (geolocation, identity verification, notifications)
Contract performance: data necessary for service delivery (ads, exchanges, chat, carpooling)
Legal obligations: data retention required by Algerian law
Legitimate interests: fraud prevention, platform security, service improvement

a4.title: Article 4 – Third-Party Services and Processors
a4.intro: Trokacha uses third-party services necessary for the operation of the platform. These providers act as data processors and are contractually bound to respect data confidentiality:

s1.title: 4.1 – Firebase (Google LLC)
items: Firebase Authentication: user registration and login management
Cloud Firestore: secure storage of application data (ads, profiles, messages)
Firebase Storage: image hosting (ad photos, profile photos)
Firebase Cloud Messaging: push notification delivery
Firebase Crashlytics: technical error detection and correction (anonymized data)

s2.title: 4.2 – Expo / React Native
s2.content: Technical infrastructure for the development and distribution of the mobile application. No personal user data is shared with Expo.

s3.title: 4.3 – Analytics Services
s3.content: If analytics tools are enabled (Firebase Analytics or similar), the data collected is anonymized and used solely to improve the user experience. The user can opt out of this collection in the application settings.

a5.title: Article 5 – Your Rights
a5.intro: In accordance with Law 18-07, you have the following rights:
items: Right of access: obtain all your personal data held by Trokacha
Right to rectification: correct any inaccurate or incomplete data
Right to erasure: request deletion of your data (right to be forgotten)
Right to object: object to the processing of your data on legitimate grounds
Right to restriction: request restriction of processing in certain circumstances
Right to portability: receive your data in a structured and readable format
Right to withdraw consent: withdraw your consent at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of prior processing
a5.contact: These rights can be exercised by contacting
a5.responseDelay: Trokacha commits to responding to any request within a maximum of 30 days.

a6.title: Article 6 – Data Retention
a6.intro: Personal data is retained according to the following periods:
items: Active account data: retained during the period of account use
Inactive account: data is retained for 3 years after last activity
After account deletion: data is archived in accordance with legal obligations then permanently deleted
Identity verification data (ID photos/selfie): deleted within 30 days of validation
Chat messages: retained during the account lifetime, then deleted with the account
Diagnostic and crash data: retained for a maximum of 90 days

a7.title: Article 7 – Data Security
a7.intro: Trokacha implements appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect personal data:
items: Data encryption in transit (TLS/SSL) and at rest
Enhanced encryption for sensitive data (identity documents, driver's licenses)
Firebase security rules (Firestore Security Rules) limiting access to authorized data only
Strict authentication-based access controls
Regular security audits
Regular data backups

a8.title: Article 8 – Breach Notification
a8.intro: In the event of a data breach likely to result in a high risk to your rights and freedoms:
items: The ANPDP will be notified within 5 days (in accordance with Law 11-25)
Affected users will be informed as soon as possible via in-app notification and/or email
The notification will include: the nature of the breach, the data concerned, the measures taken and recommendations for users

a9.title: Article 9 – Data Transfers
a9.content: Personal data is processed through Google's Firebase services, whose servers may be located outside Algeria (European Union, United States).
a9.guarantees: Trokacha ensures that these transfers benefit from adequate safeguards:
items: Google complies with international data protection standards (SOC 2, ISO 27001 certifications)
Standard contractual clauses govern these transfers
Any prior authorization required from the ANPDP will be obtained in accordance with applicable law

a10.title: Article 10 – Minor Users
a10.content: Trokacha is not intended for persons under 18 years of age. No minor user may create an account on the platform.
a10.discovery: If Trokacha discovers that a user is a minor, their account will be immediately suspended and their data deleted within 48 hours.
a10.parent: If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child has created an account on Trokacha, please contact us at

a11.title: Article 11 – Technical Identifiers and Cookies
a11.intro: The Trokacha mobile application does not use cookies. However, the following technologies may be used:
items: Device identifier: used for push notification delivery and account security
Authentication tokens: stored locally on your device to maintain your logged-in session
Advertising identifier (Advertising ID): not used by Trokacha. No data is shared for advertising purposes
a11.website: The trokacha.com website may use technical cookies necessary for its operation. No advertising tracking cookies are used.

a12.title: Article 12 – Policy Modifications
a12.intro: Trokacha reserves the right to modify this privacy policy at any time. Users will be informed of any substantial modification by:
items: In-app notification
Update of the "last updated" date at the top of this document
a12.note: Continued use of Trokacha after notification constitutes acceptance of the modified policy.

a13.title: Article 13 – Right to Complain
a13.intro: If you believe your rights have not been respected, you may:
items: Contact Trokacha at contact@trokacha.com
File a complaint with the National Personal Data Protection Authority (ANPDP)

echange.stepsSubtitle: From posting to rating, follow each step of your exchange

step1.title: Post your ad
step1.description: Take quality photos, add a detailed description and set your price or what you're looking for in exchange.
step1.tip: Clear photos and a complete description increase your chances of receiving offers!

step2.title: Browse the ads
step2.description: Explore offers from other users. Filter by category, location or type of exchange desired.
step2.tip: Use filters to find exactly what you're looking for faster.

step3.title: Make an offer
step3.description: Interested in a listing? Open it, tap "Make an offer" and pick 1 or 2 of your items, cash, or both.
step3.tip: Suggest a fair price or an item of similar value: your offer is more likely to catch their interest.

step4.title: "I'm interested"
step4.description: Whoever receives your offer can tap "I'm interested": the chat opens and nothing is reserved yet. They can be interested in several offers before choosing.
step4.tip: Until it is concluded, either side can change their mind.

step5.title: Conclude
step5.description: Made their choice? They tap "Conclude with you": the items are reserved for this exchange and the other offers are notified.
step5.tip: Your offer is a commitment: no need to confirm again, the exchange moves on right away.

step6.title: Set the meeting
step6.description: Pick the day, the time and a public place together. On the spot, check what each of you brings, then tap "The exchange is done".
step6.tip: Choose a public and secure place for your in-person exchanges.

step7.title: Rate and finish
step7.description: After the exchange, rate your experience. Your reviews help the community identify trustworthy users.
step7.tip: A good rating helps you build your reputation on the platform!

rental.title: And for a rental?
rental.description: Cars, homes: pick your dates and tap “Request the rental”. As soon as the owner accepts, the dates are booked for you. Key handover and return are recorded in the app.
